title: An item definition, config/items/<type>.yaml
description: One item type's definition (items.md, "What a section definition holds", "Item attributes"; F-137 D1 and D9). `additionalProperties` is false at each level, so a typo is a fault. `parents` and `child_limits` configure the containment graph (graphs.md, "Containment", D-603; F-148 D1). The loader adds no defaults (tenet 6).

dir.description: The directory of the type's items, relative to the backlog repo's root, for example `stories` (F-137 D1): one or more names joined by `/`, none of them `.` or `..`, so it is never empty, absolute or outside the backlog. bl has no default.

sections.description: The type's sections, in their order in the item document (D-756 to D-759).

purpose.description: What goes in the section, for agents and people.

required.description: Whether every item of the type must have the section.

initial.description: The content of a new item's section, for example `None.`; empty if not set.

attributes.description: The type's attributes, stored in the item's `attributes.json` (D-610).

schema.description: A JSON Schema for the attribute's value, as an object; `{}` accepts any value.

required.description: Whether every item of the type must have a value.

parents.description: The type's parent slots in the containment graph, declared on the child (graphs.md, "Containment", D-603). Each slot holds from `min` to `max` parents.

name.description: The slot's name, the key of the child's containment entry.

types.description: The item types a parent in the slot may have.

min.description: The fewest parents the slot holds.

max.description: The most parents the slot holds; above 1, the slot holds a list of ids (D-604).

child_limits.description: The most children of the given types that one item of this type holds in the containment graph (graphs.md, "Containment"). A type in no entry has no limit.

types.description: The child item types the limit counts together.

max.description: The most children of those types.
